data.raw_text:
Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday relieved from their posts officials of the Makati City Fire Station, whose parked vehicles blocked the fire truck driveway when he conducted a surprise inspection of the facility.

Click the photo to read the full story: https://t.co/WwAF3f8Kda

[7:17PM] #Mile2 #TrafficUpdate 

Good traffic flow from Ijesha through Second Rainbow to Mile 2.
Congested traffic on the return journey inward Oshodi, attributable to the evening rush hour.

Good movement from Sulu to Signal Barracks, but slow movement underneath Mile 2 bridge.
Smooth traffic flow from Durbar to Festac First Gate through Agboju to Oluti.
Busy traffic around Alakija to Abule Ado, with very slow movement in Alakija (both Festac side and Navy Town) due to evening rush hour.

Return journey is good traffic flow from Abule Ado through Alakija to Agboju, Mazamaza, and down to Ecomog.
Slow traffic from Ecomog to Car Wash, with slow ascent on Mile 2 bridge due to evening rush.

Slightly busy traffic at the four cardinal angles of AppleJunction, resulting from evening rush hour.

Officers strategically on ground to manage and facilitate traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[7:25PM] #Surulere #TrafficUpdate

Alaka, impacting both the main carriageway and service lanes, with congestion extending beyond Eko Bridge.
Bodethomas and its surrounding areas, primarily attributable to the evening rush hour.
Heightened traffic activity at Costain Roundabout, specifically in the inward direction towards Breweries, resulting from the combined effects of evening rush hour and commercial activities.

Traffic officers are visibly on ground actively engaged in monitoring the traffic situation to ensure smooth flow.

The stretch from Ajayi down to Jungle is currently experiencing fast movement.

In contrast, inward Toyin route from Ishaga Roundabout is experiencing moderately busy traffic conditions, although vehicular movement is still progressing.

#FollowLASTMA
